These minimal DOCX fixtures were created locally for extraction tests. They contain
only an OOXML content-types file, the main document relationship, and document XML.

- `simple.docx`: two paragraphs, “Lavalleja nació en Minas.” and “Documento de prueba para RAG1.”
- `empty.docx`: one empty paragraph.

They exercise real ZIP/XML extraction, including UTF-8 text, without Word or Ollama.
